cues: Couplet one opens like a blessing.
O ye who travel the meridian line: O ye is the old language of the Bible and public prayer, lifting the poem into ceremony.
Then may: the grammar of wishing.
Six of the seven couplets are wishes or statements; not one is an order.
The vision of a new world is to shine within you, so change begins inside.
And shine starts a chain of light running through the whole poem.
